@@ 45 | Opening
Welcome in. Twelve minutes today, all seated or on the bench. Grab one pair of light dumbbells and a mat.

Usual rules. Move only as far as feels easy, and sharp pain means stop that movement. [pause 2s]

@@ 60 | Minute one
Minute one of twelve. Seated arm circles. Arms out to the sides, below shoulder height.

Small circles forward, slow and smooth. In nineteen sixty-nine, two people walked on the Moon while a third circled overhead, waiting to fly them home.

Reverse the circles. Breathe out as they open. Three... two... one... rest.

@@ 60 | Minute two
Minute two of twelve. Forty-five on, fifteen off. Seated curls. At the bell, go. [chime] Curl. One second up, three down.

Halfway. Keep the elbows pinned. [pause 3s] [chime] Rest. Next up, the bench.

@@ 40 | Close
Box breathing. In for four. [pause 4s] Hold. [pause 4s] Out for four. [pause 4s] Hold. [pause 4s]

That's the session. Nicely done.
